answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1535 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mesa. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the thread queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. The wharf index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Collateral of 48 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
